concerns: No quantified baseline: proposal does not show what fraction of currently-passing entries carry non-positive net EV after realized spread/slippage; effect size is pure conjecture
Falsification text cut off mid-sentence ('compare an a…') — evaluation arm, EV threshold, sample window, and decision rule are unspecified
Mechanism mismatch: an EV-aware gate filters entries out; 'improve throughput' is the wrong predicted signature and would make the test unfalsifiable as stated
bot/intel/ is runtime-consumed by the designated broker-execution owner; unflagged gate-semantics edits risk silently altering live DEMO behavior outside a controlled experiment
No commitment to ExperimentRegistry recording, which is mandatory for every experiment
Composition risk with existing remaining-EV/abstention controls: duplicate or conflicting cost models could double-charge spreads or disagree on abstention
Lookahead guard is asserted (quote-time spreads at decision time) but must be verified in implementation, not assumed
votes.reason: The core idea is sound and safety-clean: gating validated-state on EV net of realized entry-time costs directly serves the repo's 'costs and lookahead matter' rule and strengthens prediction abstention rather than weakening it. Replay-only testing through the sealed-OOS path is read-only, DEMO-scoped, and trivially reversible, so no safety violation exists. However, the trigger evidence is empty (PF=None, EV=None — no demonstrated baseline that confidence-passing entries are net-negative after costs), the falsification test is truncated mid-specification (comparison arm and threshold undefined), and the stated mechanism ('improve exploration/validation throughput') contradicts what an EV filter does — it should raise per-trade net expectancy while plausibly reducing validated-entry count. The change also touches bot/intel/, which the governed DEMO execution owner consumes, so runtime gate semantics cannot change without a default-off flag and prior replay evidence.
requested_revisions: Run the read-only baseline replay FIRST and attach numbers: distribution of decision-time net EV across entries passing the current confidence/validation gate, share below zero, over a defined recent window

Complete the falsification spec: explicit comparison arm (confidence-only vs EV-aware), EV threshold value or calibration rule, evaluation window, primary metric (net costed expectancy per trade), and minimum sample size
Restate expected mechanism coherently — e.g. 'reduce negative-EV admissions / increase per-trade net expectancy even if validated count falls' — and tie success/failure metrics to it

Scope implementation: replay/sealed-OOS analysis only initially; any runtime gate change lands behind an explicit research-config flag defaulting OFF; PROTECTED_LIVE_YAML and all non-designated trading YAML untouched; no champion-path changes
Register the experiment in ExperimentRegistry before execution and commit to honest reporting of failures per repo rules
Specify single-source-of-truth composition with existing EV/spread/abstention controls so costs are charged exactly once
